richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to either clean the axle and housing and fit new seals or where necessary replace the rear calipers.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the shift cable may have been installed incorrectly causing tension on the cable not anticipated in the design.  If present this condition could cause the cable to detach from the shiftier assembly's dowel pin preventing the transmission from being shifted.  The shift lever can then be moved into the park (P) position while the transmission is still in the last used gear before detachment.  If the driver leaves the vehicle without engaging the parking brake there is a possibility the vehicle can roll creating the risk of a crash.
richiami.rimedio: Vehicles affected will have the cable inspected to ensure it is fitted correctly if incorrect the cable will be refitted with a new mounting bush.
richiami.titolo: SHIFT LEVER MAY NOT ENGAGE

richiami.difetto: The wiring to the mood lighting in the doors may overheat in use and if ignored there is a potential risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles to have the wiring to the mood lights replaced.

richiami.difetto: It has been established that the plastic cooling fan blades could fracture and damage the cooling system/hoses causing the engine to overheat and possibly fail.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the engine cooling fan replaced with a modified unit.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE COOLING FAN BLADES COULD FRACTURE AND DAMAGE THE COOLING SYSTEM.

richiami.difetto: The product poses risk of injuries because there is a possibility of breakage of the cooling fan blades. The broken blades could destroy important parts of the vehicle’s engine, like the cooler, leading to damage to the engine while the car is in motion. This could then be a reason for a road accident.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that some of the wires to the airbag control unit are not in the correct order. In consequence an incorrect side curtain airbag could deploy in the event of a collision.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the pins on the connector to the control unit refitted in the correct order.
richiami.titolo: CURTAIN AIRBAGS MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: The wiring to the driver's electric seat adjuster may chafe on the sharp edge of the seat base which may result in an electrical short circuit. This can cause the wiring and fuse-box to overheat and a risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the routing of the wiring checked and any sharp edges will be insulated.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: Poor rear wheel bearing cap sealing arrangement can lead to moisture accumulating in the rear wheel bearing and possible failure.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the likely to be affected vehicles and fit modified caps. Any faulty bearings will also be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF REAR BEARING FAILURE

richiami.difetto: An incorrect engine oil pump strainer may have been fitted during production. This can result in the oil supply to the engine being affected and an engine seizure.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the engine oil pump strainer replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF ENGINE SIEZURE

richiami.difetto: The parking brake may fail to engage or release without warning due to an incorrectly manufactured parking brake lever locking pawl.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the parking brake lever assembly replaced with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: HANDBRAKE MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: Due to incorrect logic in the electronic stability programme (ESP)control unit the possibility exists that the brakes may suddenly apply.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and re-programme the ESP control unit
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SUDDEN OPERATION OF BRAKES

richiami.difetto: The snap ring which retains the reverse gear may break which may result in poor power transfer. Should this occur the vehicle may roll forward whilst in reverse gear.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and fit a modified transmission unit.
richiami.titolo: SNAP RING RETAINER WITHIN THE GEARBOX MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: The alternator pulley may seize resulting in the loss of the drive belt. This in turn can result in an increased physical effort requirement for both the steering and brake pedal
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the pulley will be replaced with a modified item.
richiami.titolo: ALTERNATOR PULLEY MAY SEIZE

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the inlet nipple on the fuel distribution rail may crack. Should this occur the potential exists for a fuel leak additionally the risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the distribution rail and the fuel supply pipe will be changed.
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the power steering hose could come in contact with the metal brake pipe.  If unchecked there is potential for the metal brake pipe to chafe which could result in fluid loss.
richiami.rimedio: Return the vehicle to the dealers to check and adjust the gap between the power steering hose and metal brake pipe.  And if required replace the metal brake pipe.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE BETWEEN POWER STEERING HOSE AND BRAKE PIPE
